visualCharacteristics: Wide poster with centred WATCH button, title + duration + red CTA pill, italic description, 'FIRST UP' horizontal row of tiles below

contentPattern.rows: Row 1: poster image + video URL (featured). Row 2 (optional, no image): title heading, duration paragraph (e.g. '4:02'), CTA link paragraph ('Get the Recipe'), description paragraph. Each further row is a playlist tile: thumbnail | duration, title, video URL.
contentPattern.structure: row 1 holds the featured poster image and video URL; an optional row 2 (no image) holds the title heading, duration, CTA link and description; each further row is a playlist tile (thumbnail, duration, title, video URL)

usage.description: Featured video with its title, duration, recipe CTA and description, followed by a horizontal 'First Up' playlist of video tiles.

reuseGuidance: Use when a featured video needs a playlist. YouTube, Vimeo and direct media file URLs play inline; selecting a tile swaps it into the player. Other video URLs open in place as links. Use the plain video block for a single video with no playlist.
